# The EWS mark-all test checks eventual local state and its survival through mock sync

The unit scenario creates three unread messages, starts markAllMessagesRead, waits for local unread count zero and synchronizes before checking zero again. Its mock defaults to Exchange2013 and updates read state plus sync changes. A null window leaves undo outside this test. The browser certificate scenario also waits for unread zero before its warning-icon check. These direct assertions do not cover pre-2013 fallback, receipts, remote/local failures or a real Exchange server.

Scope: Exchange mark-all test limits.
